subject: You're in! You've been selected for HackLab x Brisa Hackathon
body:
Hi there,

Great news: you've been **selected** to take part in **HackLab – Robotics x AI Hackathon** in Berlin on **21–22 November**.

We received far more applications than we have places, so congratulations: your profile stood out.

### What's next: choosing your track

In the next few days we'll send you a short form to choose the track you'd like to work on.

Please note: we'll take your preference into account, but we can't guarantee a place in a specific track. Places in each track are limited and will be assigned in order, so we'll do our best to match everyone with their first choice.

Keep an eye on your inbox (and your spam folder) so you don't miss the form.

See you in Berlin!

The HackLab team
